svg.text: sha3_256 -- one Keccak-f[1600] round per cycle
Shift right 8 per byte, insert at bit 1087. After
136 shifts byte j sits at bits 8j+7:8j, which is
2:1 select on the state D input: the round LUT6 is
saturated so this costs its own LUT layer.
digest[7:0] is hash byte 0, the leftmost byte of the conventional
hex string. Held until init or the next message starts.
init zero the sponge, abort a message
busy first accepted byte until digest_valid
